subject: Setting outputOptions with "suspendWhenHidden=FALSE" triggers an error message

messages.author: 7edd571eb09333bc
messages.subject: Setting outputOptions with "suspendWhenHidden=FALSE" triggers an error message
parts:
Hello,

I'm currently developping a small R/Shiny application where the different inputs and outputs are separated by tabs, within a wizard.
This implies that the output tabs are hidden by default when the page is loaded (because of display: none; in the Bootstrap .tab-pane class).

But according to this thread #97, hidden outputs are suspended. I tried to apply the solution given by wch by adding the following code to my server:

outputOptions(output, "piePlot", suspendWhenHidden=FALSE)

where piePlot is the plot which is hidden by default.

When I launch the application and generate the graphics, the following message appears in place of the plot:

Error in if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return(NULL) : 
Missing value where TRUE/FALSE is required.

I don't know if that is relevant, but I use a form with an input[type="submit"] in order to trigger the plot generation.

In advance, thank you for your help.


Note: please be informed that this is a copy of an issue I posted on the project's GitHub.

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Setting outputOptions with "suspendWhenHidden=FALSE" triggers an error message
parts:
Thanks for sharing the code! It helped us find a small bug, and we also learned from it that we need to document a part about objects being shown/hidden.

The bug was that renderPlot() didn't properly handle empty values for height and width. That's been fixed and pushed to the development branch.

The second issue is that with the recent shown/hidden changes, you need to explicitly trigger a 'shown' event when objects become visible, and a 'hidden' event when they become invisible. This event (I believe) isn't a standard Javascript event that automatically gets triggered when objects become visible, so your Javascript code needs to do it. If you modify your xwizard.js file and add the following lines, it should work:

function disablePanel(panelid) {
    $("#step" + panelid).removeClass("active");
    $("#lbl-step" + panelid).removeClass("active");
    $("#lbl-step" + panelid).trigger("hidden"); // Add this line
}

function navigateToPanel(panelid) {
    $("#step" + panelid).addClass("active");
    $("#lbl-step" + panelid).addClass("active");
    $("#lbl-step" + panelid).trigger("shown"); // Add this line
}


Even with this change to the Javascript, you may momentarily see an error message when it switches to the second tab, before it is replaced by the plots. The error is related to the height/width bug I mentioned above. We're going to release a new version of Shiny to CRAN very soon, and once you update to that version, the error message should disappear.

-Winston
